metadata.description: Auto Contrast RGB8 interleaved + native planar. N=28 is the nearest round batch that keeps interleaved A100/H100 timings in the 1-2ms window.
Auto Contrast RGBf32 interleaved + planar. N=24 is a round batch calibrated to the 1-2ms interleaved A100/H100 window.
Auto Contrast RGB8 native-planar Tensor comparison for the advanced fake-planar row.
Auto Contrast U16 1-channel interleaved (single-channel -> advanced per RGB R3). N=64 is a round batch calibrated to the 1-2ms A100/H100 window.
Auto Contrast RGB8 fake-planar (tensor-only; ~3x traffic). Shares uchar3 N=28 (BEN-SIZE); fake-planar may run longer than 1-2ms.
Auto Contrast RGBA8 interleaved + planar (uchar4 planar var-shape unsupported). N=20 targets the 1-2ms reference-GPU window across A100/H100 after optimization.
Auto Contrast RGBAf32 interleaved + planar. N=20 is a round batch calibrated to the 1-2ms interleaved A100/H100 window.
Auto Contrast RGBAf32 interleaved VarShape. Shares float4 N=20 (BEN-SIZE); split from the Tensor profile to avoid an unintended layout/input-kind cross-product.
Auto Contrast RGBAf32 fake-planar (tensor-only). Shares float4 N=20 (BEN-SIZE) and may run longer than 1-2ms.
Auto Contrast RGBf16 interleaved + native planar (advanced).
